verdict.rationale: Wise documents receiving payments in 40+ currencies via global account details tied to a multi-currency account. Community users confirm hands-on use of Wise Business USD account details to get paid by clients. However, several users report Wise changed USD account details with zero-day notice, which hurt founders whose clients pay on long terms. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on which currencies get local (domestic-rail) details, and evidence of stable, long-lived account details.
